title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The hat on the hook
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The fourth card, May: a man hanging by one foot, calm. He redraws it as the tavern regular's hat on its hook by the door — the 2007 regular's, the man gone, the hat hanging by its band, calm. The card's figure is a hat. He's not sure that's allowed. He does it.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: a worn hat hanging by its band from a single hook on a tavern's wall beside a door, drawn upside down as if hung by one foot, the bare bulb above it. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
